landing.heroTitle: Publish anywhere. Know everyone who clicks.
landing.heroBody: SpellPaw is a content engine for AI-native builders: schedule posts across channels, attach tracked short links, and watch a Customer Graph grow from every real click — with AI-ready persona and lifecycle state on top.

f1.title: One composer, every channel
f1.body: Write once, adapt per channel, AI-rewrite on demand. Queue and schedule with a resilient BullMQ pipeline — publish, then forget.

f2.title: Tracked links, real signals
f2.body: Every post can carry a self-hosted short link. Clicks turn into Content Touches on your Customer Graph — no third-party analytics required.

f3.title: Lifecycle intelligence
f3.body: Contacts progress from AWARE to ENGAGED as they touch your content. Persona signals stay AI-derived and PII-free by design.

s1.quote: I ship a launch thread every week. The tracked links tell me which post actually moved people — not vanity impressions.

s2.quote: An MCP client drafts and schedules my content; I approve the publish path. My audience graph grows while I sleep.

s3.quote: I own my data. Postgres, Redis, my own model keys — no black box between my content and my audience.

landing.finalBody: Start with one channel and one tracked link. The graph does the rest.
landing.footerTag: customer lifecycle intelligence for AI-native builders
